title: http-passwd
author: Unknown
description: Checks if a web server is vulnerable to directory traversal by attempting to retrieve /etc/passwd or \boot.ini. The script uses several technique: * Generic directory traversal by requesting paths like ../../../../etc/passwd. * Known specific traversals of several web servers. * Query string traversal. This sends traversals as query string parameters to paths that look like they refer to a local file name. The potential query is searched for in at the path controlled by the script argument http-passwd.root.
